definition: 17 runtime scenarios over the registered L01 capability and real seeded MockBank; the original 14 plus three bounded L01 gaps, not 17 new designs or complete BF acceptance
test_doubles: Environment.Planner always selects bills.summarize; no live model
Environment scope_authorizer and LOW risk_assessor are scripted test policy; SecurityGate and executor themselves are real
BILL-PUBLIC-09/10/11/15 inject named CALL_TIMEOUT responses at BankGateway methods
real_components: AgentHarness with real SQLite application store and scoped durable checkpointer
BankGateway and seeded MockBankService/MockBankStore with real B01/B08

cases.preconditions: U1/D1 有效会话；2026-10-14 固定银行时钟；A1/A5 完整 9 月种子流水
cases.interaction: 注册 L01 经 Harness 查询两个本人账户
cases.assertions: 18 条实际 B08 流水；gross=586400/refund=4500/net=581900 分；逐笔独立复算；七类与 source_as_of 完整；真实安全门允许

cases.preconditions: 有效会话，两个本人账户；用户未指定账户
cases.interaction: 先展示真实 B01 账户选项，选择主账户后沿原任务继续
cases.assertions: 选择前无 B08；成功范围仅被选账户；每笔实际 B08 读取均为该账户；金额与该账户银行事实一致

cases.dimension: 缺月份澄清与逐项补齐
cases.preconditions: 有效会话；未确认月份和账户
cases.interaction: 先等月份，选上月，再选所有本人账户；每次 resume 由真实 checkpoint 重建 Entry
cases.assertions: 月份选择前零银行读取；最终 T1/R3；9 月完整范围和金额与真实 B08 一致

cases.dimension: 餐饮明细与原退款信息
cases.spec: 公共契约 §5.3 BillDetails / M16；§5.9 M11
cases.preconditions: 9 月有两笔餐饮消费和一笔关联 8 月原单的退款；部分渠道为 null
cases.interaction: 真实 L01 details 直接返回可查看明细
cases.assertions: 三条有序银行事实逐字段相等；退款类别复查原单；未知渠道保持 null；不创建报告或验证；不声称已验专业脱敏

cases.dimension: 退款/转账/利息分离与排除转账
cases.spec: 公共契约 §5.3 / M05；§5.9 M11；票 08 否定词返修
cases.preconditions: 9 月含退款、转入、利息；7 月额外有真实 50000 分转出
cases.input: 2026年9月所有账户不含转账消费统计
cases.interaction: 查询 9 月消费口径，再以独立 T2 查询 7 月同一否定口径
cases.assertions: 消费 gross-refund=net，不混转账/利息；7 月 transfer_out=50000 单列；不把不含转账误答成转账支出；两次任务仍计一个运行场景

cases.preconditions: 银行允许 2024 年 11 月范围，种子完整返回空集
cases.interaction: 实际 B08 成功完整读取后说明没有记录
cases.assertions: succeeded、transaction_count=0；金额为零、所有 share_bps=null；真实调用存在；消息明确没有记录

cases.dimension: 银行拒绝不支持的历史范围
cases.preconditions: 银行仍按自己的最近 24 个月规则判断范围
cases.interaction: 保留用户原 2020 年范围交给真实银行，再返回明确拒绝
cases.assertions: failed、data=null、code/upstream_code=RANGE_UNSUPPORTED；所有尝试仍是 2020 年，未缩短后伪装成功；不计最小越界边界已测

cases.dimension: 真实安全门对拒绝裁决的业务响应
cases.spec: 公共契约 §5.3 登录读取；账单只读权限边界
cases.preconditions: 有效会话，但本样本 scripted scope_authorizer 返回不允许
cases.interaction: 真实 SecurityGate 在 BankGateway 前拒绝
cases.assertions: failed、source=security、data=null；bank reads=0；真实 block 决策；仅证明业务响应，不代替攻击检测或生产策略审查

cases.dimension: B01 失败后原任务重试
cases.preconditions: list_accounts 首轮注入 CALL_TIMEOUT，恢复后调用真实银行
cases.interaction: 等待重新查询原范围，点击后继续 T1
cases.assertions: 首轮 waiting_input/data=null 且无 B08；恢复真实 B01/B08 后 T1/R2 succeeded，金额与银行事实相等
cases.fault_injection: BankGateway.list_accounts CALL_TIMEOUT until explicit user retry

cases.dimension: B08 失败后原任务重试
cases.preconditions: 真实 B01 可用；list_transactions 首轮注入 CALL_TIMEOUT
cases.interaction: 失败等待；恢复真实 B08 后只读重试原范围
cases.assertions: 首轮 waiting_input/data=null；恢复后 T1/R2 succeeded，完整金额由真实银行逐笔复算；不冒称超时检测器通过
cases.fault_injection: BankGateway.list_transactions CALL_TIMEOUT until explicit user retry

cases.dimension: 多账户部分成功不伪装完整
cases.preconditions: A1 使用真实 B08 成功，A5 注入 CALL_TIMEOUT
cases.interaction: 第一个账户成功后第二个失败，保持原任务等待重试
cases.assertions: 确有一次真实账户成功和一次注入失败；整体 waiting_input/data=null，不能把 A1 金额当全部账户；不跳过坏账户

cases.preconditions: 首次真实 L01 查询成功后，复用相同 request_id 与输入
cases.interaction: Harness 返回既有任务结果
cases.assertions: 两次 ModuleResult 相等，银行读取次数不增；这是 Harness 防重，不能替代票 09 的模块防重变异验证

cases.dimension: 取消后旧选项不复活任务
cases.preconditions: T1 尚在等待月份，保留旧选项 ID
cases.interaction: 取消 T1 后再次回传旧月份选项
cases.assertions: 取消结果和旧选项重放均为 cancelled/data=null；始终零银行读取；不以宽泛捕获异常充当通过

cases.preconditions: S1 的 T1 等待月份，同一 U1/D1 建立 S2
cases.interaction: recover_session 后确认继续，再选月份和账户，沿原任务真实查询
cases.assertions: 旧选项不复用，恢复时零银行读取；最终 T1/R5 成功且持久化 session_id=S2；不是断电/进程崩溃恢复证据

cases.dimension: 跨月退款原单补查失败与原任务重试
cases.spec: 公共契约 §5.3 完整性；§5.9 M11
cases.preconditions: 两个账户9月主范围真实B08均成功；仅补查关联8月原退款单的窄范围注入CALL_TIMEOUT
cases.interaction: 缺原单依据时等待重新查询原范围；恢复银行后沿同一T1继续
cases.assertions: 主范围成功不掩盖原单缺失；首轮waiting_input/data=null；重试T1/R2成功，18条本期记录，gross/refund/net=586400/4500/581900分；原单不重计入9月
cases.fault_injection: BankGateway.list_transactions CALL_TIMEOUT only for the bank-proven refund-original account and exact one-microsecond range

cases.dimension: 非空账户范围的类别无匹配明细
cases.preconditions: 储蓄账户A5的9月银行流水非空，含医疗/居住消费，没有餐饮匹配
cases.interaction: 先展示真实账户选项，用户选A5后完整取数并筛选餐饮
cases.assertions: 选择前无B08，选择后只读A5；原范围确有流水但BillDetails.transactions为空；scope/source_as_of完整且消息说明没有匹配记录

cases.dimension: 排除普通类别先澄清再明确改口径
cases.spec: BF05；票08否定口径返修；公共契约 §5.3
cases.preconditions: 用户明确排除餐饮，现有L01对话不支持任意类别减除；完整9月银行种子可用
cases.input: 2026年9月所有账户不含餐饮账单
cases.interaction: 任何银行读取前先等用户选查看全部类别，确认新口径后沿原T1继续
cases.assertions: 首轮waiting_input/data=null且零银行读取；仅显式选择后T1/R2成功；最终餐饮仍有实际支出，完整18条/净581900分，不静默扩大范围

blocked_paths.reason: Needs the integrated public report resource and ordinary export path; no report resource exists in this L01 evaluation.

blocked_paths.reason: Needs trusted public verification/resource integration; this scope-authorizer test policy cannot sign off sensitive export.

blocked_paths.reason: This runner supplies a scripted planner and no live provider configuration or running HTTP service; no real-model/HTTP evidence is available.

blocked_paths.reason: Requires the actual UI/runtime joint environment; no browser or page execution occurs here.

blocked_paths.reason: Business reactions to test policy are measured separately; no professional detector or production-policy approval is inferred.

remaining_coverage: Phase 1 has 17 L01 public runtime scenarios (the original 14 plus three bounded follow-ups). It does not satisfy every subfunction >=10 or every exception type >=3; the same 96 historical designs are not promoted wholesale.

L01 structured comparison success/failure, exact retention endpoints, alternative time parsing, correction after success, and additional distinct error classes still need executable public cases. These are missing cases, not external Blocked dependencies.
The permission-denial scenario is not a cross-user attack or expired-session sample. The replay scenario verifies Harness dedup only; ticket 09 separately covers the module guard.
Recovery in phase 1 means new Entry instances and cross-session SQLite continuation, not a killed/restarted operating-system process.
Existing arithmetic results 147=130+17 and the overlapping 50 evals-only tests are historical separate layers; do not add them to these public business scenarios as unique coverage.
